result.title: KL Before and After Mixing: A Round-Complexity Separation in Parallel Sampling
result.comment: 15 pages of main text; 169 pages total including references and appendices; 7 figures. Formal proof materials included as ancillary files
result.summary: A parallel sampler can choose at random which coordinates to generate together. For a target $p$ and the output law $q_U$ of a schedule $U$ drawn afresh for each output, we compare the schedule-averaged divergence $\mathbb{E}_U D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|q_U)$ with the output-law divergence $D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|\mathbb{E}_U q_U)$, in nats. Rounds commit independent draws from exact conditional marginals frozen at the round's start, each output's schedule is drawn before sampling from a finite mixture of schedules, and every scheduled round is charged. For the uniform distribution on binary strings of even length $n$ with $n/2$ ones, the least expected number of rounds at a fixed tolerance $\varepsilon>0$ is $Θ_\varepsilon((\log n)^2)$ under the first criterion but $(e^{-\varepsilon}+o(1))\log_2\ln n$ under the second, and the double-logarithmic order is attainable with the same round count on every run. For this target, a count-state recursion gives the exact least output divergence at every round cap over all causal randomized policies. The separation extends to weighted fixed-count targets with bounded weight ratios and quota fractions bounded away from zero and one, without permutation symmetry, and to the full-support Beta$(1,1)$--Bernoulli target, where the sharp expected cost under the output-law criterion is $(e^{-\varepsilon}/2+o(1))\log_2\log_2n$, attained with rare $n$-round runs. Prior work implies the order of the schedule-averaged cost on the balanced target and its $O_\varepsilon((\log n)^2)$ upper bounds on both extensions.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究并行采样的轮数复杂度：在每轮冻结条件边际、随机调度并计费轮数的设定下，比较「调度平均 KL」与「输出分布 KL」两个准则，证明均衡目标上最小期望轮数呈 (log n)^2 与 log log n 量级的分离，并给出精确的因果策略递推。
AI.relevance_reason: 其调度平均与输出分布两类 KL 准则、以及「轮数—偏差」的因果策略递推，可能为并行生成 latent 推理状态时的评价口径与动态计算/停止成本分析提供形式化参照，但属远领域概念迁移，需核查是否可对应到 LVR 的并行状态生成与相似度度量。
